summary: NHLR lists a Mauch Chunk tower in Weiser State Forest, Carbon County, built by CCC crews in 1936. Forest Lookouts describes a 1925 tower moved to Bear Mountain above Mauch Chunk; the sources do not link it to the 1936 tower. Current condition unverified.

notes_for_editor: Build-date conflict is unresolved: NHLR says CCC crews built an Aermotor tower in 1936, while Forest Lookouts (Bear Mountain and Christman pages) shows a 60-foot steel tower moved from Christman's to a higher point on Bear Mountain in 1925; the July 1925 item calls its new site Jew's Head and does not name Bear Mountain. None of the pages read link the Register's 1936 tower to the 1925 tower or to Bear Mountain, so the story no longer places the Register tower on Bear Mountain. The sources do not say whether the 1936 tower replaced it. The Forest Lookouts Mauch Chunk page's 1940 and 1943 items do not name a site, so they are not tied to Bear Mountain in the story. Its 1933 item about an 80-foot tower on Broad Mountain is left out as a possibly different site. The NHLR page does not state that the tower is standing; the brief's 'standing' is unverified. Search snippets (WNEP, two articles, and AllTrails) mention a 2018 replacement or rebuild on Bear Mountain, but all three returned 403 to fetch, so they are not used or quoted; verify them before any statement about current condition. The brief's access 'unknown' is unchanged.
